desc: Tactigami is a patented storage solution by Vertx, designed with maximum organization in mind. Constructed using Velcro Brand One-Wrap, Tactigami is compatible with every Vertx bag and pack or any hook and loop compatible platform. Completely customize your loadout by strategically placing multiple pieces in your pack or cut down your Tactigami to perfectly fit your kit. Constructed of VELCRO Brand ONE-WRAP fasteners. Customized to work with any standard MOLLE attachment systems pouch.
